title: Wild Smoked Russian Persian Cucumber Skewers
description: A paleo-friendly Russian dish featuring Persian cucumber, with a smoky and umami flavor profile, perfect for a energizing snack. This recipe combines the freshness of cucumbers with the richness of smoked ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the sliced cucumbers to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Thread the cucumber slices, smoked salmon, and chopped fresh dill onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and lemon juice.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the cucumbers are slightly charred.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional chopped fresh dill if desired.
Let the skewers cool for a few minutes before serving.
